setup.contract: short return cliquet on notional 100: 8 resets, each period's return floored at 0 and capped at 0.025, the sum capped at 0.06
setup.hedge: a European basket (1 call, 0.25 put, strike 100) whose exposure the agent chooses each period
setup.hidden: the previous reset spot and the accrued capped return are not observed

static_vanilla.label: Static vanilla basket
static_vanilla.summary: The best fixed exposure to the put-call basket

oracle_cap_exit.label: Full-state cap exit
oracle_cap_exit.summary: A rule that sees the contract state and exits once capped

reactive.label: Reactive
reactive.summary: Acts on the current observation only

sequential.label: Pretrain then freeze
sequential.summary: Recurrent AIS learned first, then frozen while the policy learns

concurrent.label: Concurrent recurrent AIS
concurrent.summary: AIS and policy learned together on two timescales

oracle_state.label: Exact contract state
oracle_state.summary: Sees the reset spot and accrued return directly
